# Setup

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggridges)
library(ggalluvial)
library(forcats)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(ggConvexHull)
library(UpSetR)

# Specify function
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate
rename <- dplyr::rename

# Set ggplot2 defaults
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(
  "point",
  list(size = 2, alpha = 0.6)
)

# Source scripts
source("../scripts/functions/themes_palettes.R")

# Read data
metadata <- read_csv("../data/metadata/metadata.csv")
data_long <- read_csv("../data/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/data_wide.csv")
```

# Figure 3

## Figure 3A

```{r}
# 1. Define CD4/CD8 category levels (legend order)
cd4cd8_levels <- c("Normal", "Low", "Very low")

# 2. Define subgroup order
subgroup_levels <- c(
  "Elite controller",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Primary HIV infection"
)

cd4cd8_followup <- cd4cd8_followup |>
  mutate(Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels))

p_cd4cd8_followup <- ggplot(cd4cd8_followup,
                            aes(x = Subgroup, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  
  # Larger numbers inside bars
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black",
    size = 7
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "CD4/CD8 T-cell count status",
    values = c(
      "Very low" = "#d95f02",
      "Low"      = "grey80",
      "Normal"   = "#1b9e77"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(labels = subgroup_labels_fu) +
  
  # Ensure axis numbers appear
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
    name = "Number of individuals",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)
  ) +
  
  labs(
  title = "Follow-up CD4/CD8 T-cell count status by HIV-1 subgroup",
  x = "HIV-1 subgroup",
  y = "Number of individuals",
  fill = "CD4/CD8 Status"
) +
  
  coord_flip() +
  theme_hiv()

p_cd4cd8_followup
```

## Supplementary Figure 3

### Supplementary Figure 3A

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# ---------------------------
# Proteins of interest
# ---------------------------
proteins_of_interest <- c("SIGLEC1", "LGALS9")

# ---------------------------
# Prepare data (LOG10 HIV RNA)
# ---------------------------
scatter_data <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
    Subgroup %in% c(
      "Primary HIV Infection",
      "More preserved immunity",
      "Severely impaired immunity"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    HIVRNA_log10 = log10(`HIV-RNA (baseline)` + 1)  # 🔑 log-transform here
  ) |>
  select(
    DAid,
    HIVRNA_log10
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(HIVRNA_log10)) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  pivot_longer(
    -c(DAid, HIVRNA_log10),
    names_to  = "Assay",
    values_to = "NPX"
  ) |>
  filter(
    Assay %in% proteins_of_interest,
    !is.na(NPX)
  ) |>
  left_join(
    metadata %>% select(DAid, Subgroup),
    by = "DAid"
  )

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
p_hivrna_corr <- ggplot(
  scatter_data,
  aes(x = HIVRNA_log10, y = NPX, color = Subgroup, fill = Subgroup)
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(
    method = "spearman",
    label.x.npc = "left",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    size = 4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Assay, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = expression(log[10] * " HIV RNA at baseline (copies/mL)"),
    y = "Protein level (NPX)",
    title = "Baseline HIV RNA vs protein levels",
    subtitle = "SIGLEC1 and LGALS9 (pooled HIV subgroups)"
  )

p_hivrna_corr


ggsave(
  filename = "HIVRNA_vs_SIGLEC1_LGALS9.png",
  plot     = p_hivrna_corr,
  path     = "../plots/png/scatter/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7
)

ggsave(
  filename = "HIVRNA_vs_SIGLEC1_LGALS9.pdf",
  plot     = p_hivrna_corr,
  path     = "../plots/pdf/scatter/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7
)
```
